title: Rees On Western Lake | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascend to the upper levels where each bedroom serves as a private retreat, including a master suite with a soaking tub and steam shower. The second floor hosts additional bedrooms, each with private bathrooms, and another laundry facility for convenience. The home's third floor is a paradise for younger guests with a custom-built bunk room and a game room equipped with a billiards table, shuffleboard, and a card table. A unique fourth-floor tower offers a bar and seating area, presenting breathtaking views of Watercolor, Seaside, and glimpses of the Gulf. Outside, the expansive amenities continue with a private heated pool, an outdoor kitchen with a gas grill, and a cozy fire-pit area, complemented by a ping pong table for entertainment. This home isn’t just a place to stay; it’s a luxurious escape designed to create unforgettable memories in a picturesque coastal setting.
